card.name: Inside brand names and acronyms
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a letter or short piece in the middle of a capitalized brand name or acronym, such as the Q in RINVOQ LQ, the Y in ZYMFENTRA, or the H in SOPHIA. It also fires on a few other partial words like Sufi and ECO.
